summary: Cloud scan of https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com complete. Found 0 critical and 1 high vulnerabilities.

findings.title: Informational: robots.txt file found
findings.evidence: HTTP Status 200 OK. Body contains 'User-agent: *\nDisallow: /ftp', indicating exposed disallowed paths.

findings.title: Exposed Git Configuration File
findings.evidence:
HTTP Status 200 OK. Body contains '[core]
	repositoryformatversion = 0
	filemode = true
	bare = false
	logallrefupdates = true' and other sensitive git repository configuration details.

findings.title: Exposed package.json file
findings.evidence: HTTP Status 200 OK. Body is valid JSON: '{"name": "juice-shop", "version": "13.0.0", "description": "An intentionally insecure webapp for web security trainings written entirely in JavaScript.", "main": "app.js", "scripts": {"start": "node app.js"}, "dependencies": {"express": "^4.17.1"}}'. This exposes application metadata and dependencies.

findings.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) on User API
findings.evidence: Successful unauthorized access to other user's data by changing the ID in the URL. Request to /api/Users/1 returned `{"id": 1, "email": "admin@juice-sh.op"}`. A subsequent request to /api/Users/2 (without specific authorization for user 2) returned `{"id": 2, "email": "jim@juice-sh.op"}`. This indicates the application allows retrieval of arbitrary user profiles by manipulating the ID parameter.

findings.title: Unauthenticated IDOR on User Profiles
findings.evidence: Scanner observed successful retrieval of distinct user profile data without authentication. A GET request to /api/Users/1 returned JSON containing `"id": 1, "email": "admin@juice-sh.op", "role": "admin"` (HTTP 200 OK). Subsequently, a GET request to /api/Users/2 returned JSON containing `"id": 2, "email": "jim.admin@juice-sh.op", "role": "customer"` (HTTP 200 OK). The ability to access different user profiles by incrementing the ID in the URL without any authentication token confirms unauthorized data access.

findings.title: HSTS Missing — Forces HTTPS
findings.evidence: HTTP Response did not contain 'Strict-Transport-Security' header. Status: 503
findings.description: The response from https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com is missing the 'Strict-Transport-Security' security header.
findings.recommendation: Add the 'Strict-Transport-Security' header to all server responses.
